_readme: Calibration gate results, 2026-09-03 (scratch/gate-protocol.md). Membership: structural falses verified absent from base.json after the first build; the four judged falses and one judged true in the base were ruled blind through decisions.md + COLLECTION.md §1-3 (person, seat date, issuer address), the ten seeded trues checked for the evidence the seed claims. Stage: every candidate layer scored against golden.json before the grind; the blind replay walks each key row through the production order (class-1 document first) and records the document it lands on.

membership_blind.score: 0 false members at high confidence; 11 structural falses absent; 4/4 judged falses ruled not_member; 1/1 judged true ruled member; 10/10 seeded trues corroborated. PASS. Press-only trues (instagram, warby-parker, github, slack) are recall-probe rows by design.
